description: This file implements a profiling allocator for CPU memory management, including classes and functions for tracking memory allocations, deallocations, and planning memory layout to optimize CPU memory usage within the c10 namespace of PyTorch.

classes.name: MemBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with start and end offsets, used for tracking memory allocations.

classes.name: MemEvent
classes.description: Represents a memory event (allocation or free) with timestamp, ID, size, and type.

classes.name: AllocationPlan
classes.description: Holds the plan for memory allocations including sizes, lifetimes, and offsets.

classes.name: AllocationPlanner
classes.description: Handles recording, validating, and planning memory allocations based on observed events.

classes.name: CPUProfilingAllocator
classes.description: Custom CPU memory allocator that manages memory according to a specified allocation plan.

methods.name: validate_allocation_plan
methods.description: Validates that a sequence of memory events does not have overlapping allocations.

methods.name: create_and_sort_mem_events
methods.description: Creates and sorts memory events based on allocation sizes and lifetimes.

methods.name: formulate_greedy_allocation_plan
methods.description: Generates a memory allocation plan using a greedy algorithm based on events.

methods.name: AllocationPlan::clear
methods.description: Clears the allocation plan data.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::record_allocation
methods.description: Records a memory allocation event.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::record_free
methods.description: Records a memory free event.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::validate_allocation
methods.description: Validates an allocation against the plan.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::validate_free
methods.description: Validates a free event against the plan.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::formulate_plan
methods.description: Generates an allocation plan based on recorded events.

methods.name: AllocationPlanner::clear
methods.description: Clears the current allocation plan and internal state.

methods.name: CPUProfilingAllocator::set_plan
methods.description: Sets the allocation plan for the allocator.

methods.name: CPUProfilingAllocator::unset_plan
methods.description: Unsets the current allocation plan.

methods.name: CPUProfilingAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory according to the plan.

methods.name: CPUProfilingAllocator::free
methods.description: Frees memory, validating against the plan.

methods.name: CPUProfilingAllocator::~CPUProfilingAllocator
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated CPU memory.

methods.name: WithProfileAllocationsGuard::WithProfileAllocationsGuard
methods.description: RAII guard that creates an allocation planner and formulates a plan.

methods.name: WithProfileAllocationsGuard::~WithProfileAllocationsGuard
methods.description: Destructor that finalizes the plan.

methods.name: WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard::WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard
methods.description: RAII guard for validating an allocation plan.

methods.name: WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard::~WithValidateAllocationPlanGuard
methods.description: Destructor that reports validation success.

methods.name: GetThreadLocalAllocationPlanner
methods.description: Returns thread-local pointer to the current AllocationPlanner.

methods.name: WithProfilingAllocatorGuard::WithProfilingAllocatorGuard
methods.description: RAII guard that sets a profiling allocator and plan.

methods.name: WithProfilingAllocatorGuard::~WithProfilingAllocatorGuard
methods.description: Restores previous profiling allocator state.
